description: Contract quality of open Substrate tickets: whether a ticket is executable from its text alone, what execution requires, and whether it leaves decisions unresolved, blocks itself, or carries validation that does not demonstrate success.

legend.auc: area under the ROC curve of a quality score against the dispatchable label
legend.contract-quality.executable: P(a fresh worker could execute the ticket from its text alone)
legend.contract-quality.execution_mode: what a worker needs in order to complete the ticket
legend.contract-quality.open_decision: P(the ticket leaves a decision unresolved without naming who decides)
legend.contract-quality.self_blocked: P(the ticket is blocked on an external decision or another ticket)
legend.contract-quality.validation_covers_succe: P(the ticket's validation directly demonstrates its success condition)
legend.execution_mode_agreement: fraction of tickets whose predicted execution_mode matches the blind label

provenance.detail: questions() lines 78-98; STANDARD contract sections lines 17-27; evidence() deterministic checks lines 34-73; report() lines 153-189
